title: Yext Alternative local listing audit input
description: Audit public directory evidence for businesses you already know. The Actor audits visibility and observed NAP signals; it does not claim, create, update, suppress, or synchronize directory listings.

businesses.title: Known businesses to audit
businesses.description: One to 50 business records you already know. Each needs businessName, phone, and city; address, state, website, and externalId improve matching and are returned as caller-provided context.

businessName.title: Business name
businessName.description: The known public-facing business name, for example Example Bakery.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: The business telephone number with country code when available, for example +1 212 555 0100.

city.title: City
city.description: The business's known city, used to make directory site searches more precise.

address.title: Street address
address.description: Optional canonical street address used only for evidence comparison.

state.title: State or region
state.description: Optional canonical state, province, or region used only for evidence comparison.

website.title: Website
website.description: Optional canonical business website URL used only for evidence comparison.

externalId.title: External ID
externalId.description: Optional caller-owned CRM, spreadsheet, or location key carried through unchanged.

country.title: Search country
country.description: Google search country used for directory discovery. The v0.1 directory set is US-oriented; use another supported market only when its directories are relevant to your audit.

maxBusinesses.title: Maximum businesses to process
maxBusinesses.description: Hard cap for businesses processed in this run. Defaults to 10, accepts 1 to 50, and limits event charges to $0.25 per completed audit plus Apify platform usage.
